af te zullen schepen

glosses: onder valse voorwendselen iemand onverrichter zake wegsturen.

examples.text: We laten ons niet meer door de onbeschofte verkoper afschepen, als we onze zin niet krijgen vragen we naar zijn superieur.
Goldmann leek enorm opgelucht toen hij me aan zag komen, hij had waarschijnlijk gedacht dat ik hem had afgescheept.

Don't put your homework off to the last minute.

The storm put the game off by a week.

glosses: To distract; to disturb the concentration of.

examples.text: Please be quiet. I'm trying to concentrate and you're putting me off.

glosses: To cause to dislike; to discourage (from doing).

examples.text: Almost drowning put him off swimming.

glosses: To emit; to give off (an odor, smoke, etc.).

examples.text: This type of firewood puts off a strong smell.

The power of turning into an animal has this serious disadvantage that it lays you open to the chance of being wounded or even slain in your animal skin before you have the chance to put it off and scramble back into your human integument.
The guest was quite put off by an odor.
All but the most dedicated were put off by the huge task.
